📺 The Neighborhood (2018–Present)

The Neighborhood follows Dave Johnson, a friendly and optimistic man who moves with his wife Gemma and their son Grover from Michigan to a predominantly Black neighborhood in Pasadena, California. Excited to start a new chapter, Dave tries to build a friendship with his next-door neighbor, Calvin Butler, a proud and outspoken family man who isn’t particularly interested in welcoming his overly enthusiastic new neighbor. While Calvin’s wife Tina develops a close relationship with Gemma, their sons Malcolm and Marty become part of the hilarious situations that bring the two families together. From awkward misunderstandings and cultural differences to family disagreements, unexpected friendships, and everyday challenges, the neighbors gradually learn to appreciate one another. Starring Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, Beth Behrs, Sheaun McKinney, and Marcel Spears, the series delivers hilarious comedy, heartfelt family moments, and meaningful stories about friendship, community, acceptance, and the importance of bringing people together.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Jim Reynolds

📺 Seasons: 8 (final season)

📚 Setting: Pasadena, California

🏆 Awards: Received multiple NAACP Image Award nominations, including recognition for Cedric the Entertainer and Tichina Arnold.

📺 Where to Watch: CBS • Paramount+ (United States)
